angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 834,144 km at 107.99 pc = 0.1 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 9.2600 +/- 0.0223 mas (same row, RUWE 1.11): 107.99 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.199 +/- 0.033 solar radii from Naponiello et al. 2026, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of HD 80653 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026arXiv260719325N/abstract): 834,144 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.15 +/- 0.063 solar masses from Naponiello et al. 2026, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of HD 80653 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026arXiv260719325N/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5959 +/- 61 K from Naponiello et al. 2026, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of HD 80653 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026arXiv260719325N/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Naponiello et al. 2026, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of HD 80653 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026arXiv260719325N/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/hd-80653.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.341, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 80653 (pscomppars): spectral type G0 V, from Naponiello et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026arXiv260719325N/abstract)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, HD 80653: main object type *, Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 80653 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.255 dex, from Naponiello et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026arXiv260719325N/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 80653 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.21165, from Naponiello et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026arXiv260719325N/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 80653 (pscomppars): age 3.3 Gyr, from Naponiello et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026arXiv260719325N/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 80653 (pscomppars): rotation period 19.8 d, from Frustagli et al. 2020 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020A&A...633A.133F/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 80653 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 3.5 km/s, from Naponiello et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026arXiv260719325N/abstract)
